sights.address: 426 W Plant St, Winter Garden, FL 34787
sights.w: Indoor market and food hall of ~20 local vendors (sushi, wood-fired pizza, chocolates, Axum Coffee) built around Crooked Can Brewing, featured on Spectrum News 13's Florida on a Tankful, by Visit Florida and in Orlando Weekly's essential Winter Garden list.
Built 1956 atop a Lake County ridge as a monument to the citrus industry, the 226-ft tower's observation deck overlooks what were once rolling groves; documented by Wikipedia and Atlas Obscura.

sights.address: 1300 N Fort Christmas Rd, Christmas, FL 32709
sights.w: Orange County park with a replica of the 1837 Seminole War fort plus restored Florida Cracker houses showing rural life 1870s-1930s; covered by Wikipedia and Florida Rambler's Christmas, Florida getaway.
City-owned 1924 Aladdin Theater in Historic Cocoa Village, now the Historic Cocoa Village Playhouse staging Broadway-style musicals; on Wikipedia and profiled by Space Coast Living.
